exposure: Open maternal-fetal surgery for in utero myelomeningocele closure
outcome: Preterm delivery (<37 weeks) in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: 174 women who participated in the Management of Myelomeningocele Study, with 86 in the prenatal closure group and 88 in the postnatal closure group, for myelomeningocele closure of their fetus.
finding: Women who underwent open maternal-fetal surgery for myelomeningocele closure were more likely to experience preterm delivery and had a higher risk of uterine rupture and dehiscence in subsequent pregnancies compared to those who underwent postnatal closure.
gest_age: The initial study pregnancies (for the index child) were planned for delivery at 37 weeks gestation, or earlier if spontaneous delivery occurred.
